messages:
Anya: Quick heads up — had a pricing convo with a mid-market prospect. They're leaning to a competitor purely on cost. We need to decide: push parity (feature-heavy) or ship an economics-first slice this quarter? :thinking:

Meera: +1 for economics-first experiment. Our conversion funnel is pretty price sensitive for SME segment. Can we do a cheap tier w/ constrained perf? :chart_with_upwards_trend:

Sofia: Sales confirms — 3 pilot prospects asked explicitly for a lower $/1000-token tier. They said they'd sign if we match within ~20% of competitor pricing. They don't require all advanced routing features.

Matt: Tech feasibility check: we can reduce unit cost by combining these levers: quantized model variants, smaller context windows (4k -> 2k), prefix caching, and aggressive batching for non-interactive routes. Scope-wise it's doable as a spike (2 engineers, 2 weeks) + canary.

Ryan: UX/Docs note — economy tier needs clear tradeoff language and guardrails. e.g., "reduced context, no streaming, best-effort latency". We should avoid surprising enterprise customers.

Anya: Proposed launch criteria (draft):
- Measured unit cost delta <= -18% vs baseline for targeted queries
- Latency p95 <= 200ms for web flows (non-streaming)
- No higher than 1.5x error rate during canary
- Conversion lift >= 3% in pilot accounts or clear CLV signal

Meera: Add telemetry: token-distribution histogram, cache-hit rate, batching-size distribution. Need these to understand where savings come from.

Matt: Sketch of canary rollout config — ops can tweak percentages:```yaml
economy-canary:
  percent: 10
  duration_hours: 72
  fallback_model: rwd-medium-quantized
  allowed_routes: ["batch-embeds", "async-generation"]
  disable_streaming: true
```
We can gate on route-level flags so interactive chat customers are excluded.

ops-bot: Canary job scheduled (mock) — will run synthetic traffic and alert on latency/error thresholds.

Sofia: For GTM — pitch is "Economy Tier: same API, tuned for lower cost workloads". Sales will offer to pilot to the three prospects if we can guarantee rollback + SLA-like safety during pilot.

Anya: Risks: churn of existing customers if they mis-shelve economy-tier as the default. Mitigation: separate plan, opt-in pilot, clear labeling in Console + API. Also, watch for quality regressions (we need auto-eval on a prompt set).

Matt: Dev plan (rough):
- Week 1: implement model-variant selection + disable-streaming flag + telemetry hooks
- Week 2: prefix cache tuning + batching config + 10% canary rollout
- Week 3: monitor + extend to 25%/50% if stable, then decide GA

Meera: Metrics to track in Console: cost per 1k tokens (measured), p95 latency, error rate, cache hit, conversion lift (sales-provided).

Ryan: Docs snippets and console labels ready once canary starts. I'll draft UX copy emphasizing limitations and suggested use cases.

Anya: Decision call: approve spike + canary with pilot accounts (acme-inc, beta-co, study-startup). Budget: small promo credit for pilots. If canary meets launch criteria after 3 weeks, we'll fast-follow GA. All in favor? :thumbsup:

Matt: :+1: I'll spin up the feature branch and add feature-flag gates.

Sofia: :+1: Locking pilot list and outreach plan.

Meera: :+1: I'll own the telemetry/dashboard.

Ryan: :+1: UX copy + Console labels on my side.

Anya: Action items:
- Matt: start spike + PRD for rollout config (assign in Jira)
- Meera: dashboard + telemetry specs
- Sofia: pilot outreach + pricing ask from prospects
- Ryan: docs + Console copy
- Ops: schedule canary monitoring baseline (ops-bot)

Anya: We'll sync next Tues (30 min) — bring early telemetry + cost sims. If anything blocks this week ping here.
